hyperedges.name: dev_release_pipeline
hyperedges.description: Complete dev release pipeline: trigger on main push → compute version → publish to dev track via bakery

hyperedges.name: event_normalization_flow
hyperedges.description: Event normalization flow: raw signals from adapters → daemon normalizer → semantic events → Lua subscriptions

hyperedges.name: module_lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Module lifecycle: init.lua runs first → modules/ auto-discovered → skeleton pattern → subscriptions registered on_load

hyperedges.name: workflow_execution_flow
hyperedges.description: Workflow execution: define body → start workflow → spawn coroutine → wait for events → step tracking → completion

hyperedges.name: widget_rendering_flow
hyperedges.description: Widget rendering: register widget with typed tree → update on timer or state change → breadbar renders live

hyperedges.name: release_cycle
hyperedges.description: Single-trunk release model: work on main → dev publishes on every push → RCs tag and test on main → stable tags final release

nodes.label: Bread Daemon (breadd)
nodes.description: Long-running Rust process that normalizes hardware/OS signals into semantic events, maintains runtime state, and dispatches events to Lua modules.

nodes.label: Bread CLI (bread)
nodes.description: Command-line interface that communicates with the daemon over a Unix socket at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bread/breadd.sock.

nodes.label: Lua Runtime
nodes.description: Dedicated thread inside breadd that loads Lua modules and executes automation logic in response to events.

nodes.label: Hyprland Adapter
nodes.description: Interfaces with Hyprland compositor IPC to monitor workspace changes, window focus, and monitor connections.

nodes.label: udev Adapter
nodes.description: Monitors USB and input device hotplug events via udev/netlink to emit device connection/disconnection events.

nodes.label: Power Adapter
nodes.description: Monitors AC power and battery state via UPower D-Bus and sysfs to emit power events.

nodes.label: Network Adapter
nodes.description: Monitors network connectivity via rtnetlink and sysfs to emit network connection/disconnection events.

nodes.label: Bluetooth Adapter
nodes.description: Interfaces with BlueZ D-Bus to monitor and control Bluetooth device pairing, connection, and power state.

nodes.label: Git Adapter
nodes.description: Monitors git repositories via hooks and dirty-state poller to emit commit and branch change events.

nodes.label: Filesystem Adapter
nodes.description: Watches project root directories for file changes and build artifacts.

nodes.label: Systemd Adapter
nodes.description: Monitors systemd --user unit state changes to emit service start/stop/failure events.

nodes.label: Podman Adapter
nodes.description: Monitors Podman container lifecycle events (start, stop, health changes).

nodes.label: Monitors Module (Built-in)
nodes.description: High-level declarative monitor event handlers and layout management for display configuration.

nodes.label: Devices Module (Built-in)
nodes.description: Device connection rules with name-based matching for hardware hotplug events.

nodes.label: Workspaces Module (Built-in)
nodes.description: Workspace-to-monitor assignment and application pinning functionality.

nodes.label: Binds Module (Built-in)
nodes.description: Runtime keybind management via Hyprland dispatcher.

nodes.label: bread.device.connected
nodes.description: Emitted when a USB device or Bluetooth device connects, contains device info and raw udev properties.

nodes.label: bread.device.disconnected
nodes.description: Emitted when a USB device or Bluetooth device disconnects.

nodes.label: bread.monitor.connected
nodes.description: Emitted when an external monitor connects to the system.

nodes.label: bread.monitor.disconnected
nodes.description: Emitted when an external monitor disconnects from the system.

nodes.label: bread.workspace.changed
nodes.description: Emitted when the active workspace changes in Hyprland.

nodes.label: bread.window.opened
nodes.description: Emitted when a new window opens, contains address, workspace, class, and title.

nodes.label: bread.power.ac.connected
nodes.description: Emitted when AC adapter connects, contains ac_connected flag and battery_percent.

nodes.label: bread.power.battery.low
nodes.description: Emitted when battery level drops below threshold.

nodes.label: bread.network.connected
nodes.description: Emitted when network connection is established.

nodes.label: bread.bluetooth.device.paired
nodes.description: Emitted when a Bluetooth device is first learned by BlueZ (paired or on adapter restart).

nodes.label: bread.system.startup
nodes.description: Emitted once when breadd starts up and Lua runtime is initialized.

nodes.label: bread.on(pattern, fn)
nodes.description: Subscribe to matching events by pattern, returns subscription ID for later unsubscribe.

nodes.label: bread.wait(pattern, opts)
nodes.description: Coroutine-only: suspend until a matching event arrives; must be used with bread.spawn.

nodes.label: bread.spawn(fn)
nodes.description: Spawn a coroutine and surface errors if it fails; required for using bread.wait.

nodes.label: bread.state.watch(path, fn)
nodes.description: Watch a state path for changes, callback receives new and old values.

nodes.label: bread.exec(cmd)
nodes.description: Fire-and-forget async shell command execution.

nodes.label: bread.notify(message, opts)
nodes.description: Send a desktop notification via notify-send with optional title, urgency, timeout, and icon.

nodes.label: bread.after(delay_ms, fn)
nodes.description: Run a function once after a delay in milliseconds.

nodes.label: bread.every(interval_ms, fn)
nodes.description: Run a function on a repeating interval in milliseconds.

nodes.label: bread.workflow API
nodes.description: Multi-step automation system with define, start, step, status, and list for coroutine-based workflows with timeouts.

nodes.label: bread.widget API
nodes.description: Declarative, live-updating widget rendering system for breadbar and sibling apps with typed nodes (box, label, icon, progress).

nodes.label: bread.hyprland namespace
nodes.description: Compositor bindings for dispatching commands, setting keywords, querying state, and subscribing to raw events.

nodes.label: bread.bluetooth namespace
nodes.description: Bluetooth adapter and device control via BlueZ D-Bus with power, connect, disconnect, scan, and devices query.

nodes.label: breadd.toml Config
nodes.description: Daemon configuration file at ~/.config/bread/breadd.toml with optional settings for adapters, events, notifications, and modules.

nodes.label: init.lua Entry Point
nodes.description: Lua entry point loaded first at ~/.config/bread/init.lua; setup and startup logic goes here.

nodes.label: modules/ Directory
nodes.description: Auto-discovered Lua module directory at ~/.config/bread/modules/ where user modules are placed.

nodes.label: dev-release.yml Workflow
nodes.description: CI workflow triggered on every push to main branch; builds, tests, computes dev version, publishes to dev track via bakery.

nodes.label: rc-release.yml Workflow
nodes.description: CI workflow triggered on vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag push; builds, tests, publishes to beta track via bakery.

nodes.label: release.yml Workflow
nodes.description: CI workflow triggered on non-RC v* tag push; builds, tests, publishes to stable track and GitHub Releases.

nodes.label: Dev Version Computation
nodes.description: Computes dev version as X.Y.(Z+1)-dev.<timestamp>+<sha> from latest stable tag to ensure proper version sorting.

nodes.label: main Branch
nodes.description: Single long-lived trunk branch where all work accumulates; short-lived feature/fix branches merge back to main.

nodes.label: dev Release Track
nodes.description: Bleeding-edge track published on every push to main; auto-versioned with timestamp.

nodes.label: beta Release Track
nodes.description: Release candidate track published on vX.Y.Z-rc.N tags; version sorts below final release.

nodes.label: stable Release Track
nodes.description: Final release track published on vX.Y.Z tags; only track published to GitHub Releases.

nodes.label: Event-Driven Architecture
nodes.description: Core Bread pattern: adapters emit raw events, normalizer transforms to semantic events, Lua modules subscribe and react.

nodes.label: Module Skeleton Pattern
nodes.description: Every module calls bread.module once at top level, registers subscriptions in on_load, returns M.

nodes.label: Coroutine Workflow Pattern
nodes.description: Multi-step automations using bread.spawn, bread.wait, and bread.workflow for ordered steps with timeouts.

nodes.label: Live Widget Update Pattern
nodes.description: Widgets register with bread.widget.register, update via bread.widget.update on timers or state changes.

nodes.label: Autostart Example Module
nodes.description: Run startup commands once on bread.system.startup event.

nodes.label: Monitors Configuration Example
nodes.description: Adjust monitor resolution and layout based on external monitor connect/disconnect events.

nodes.label: Dock Workflow Example
nodes.description: Multi-step workflow for dock connection: apply layout, wait for monitor, activate profile, notify.

nodes.label: CPU Temperature Widget Example
nodes.description: Live CPU temperature display in breadbar with color warning at threshold.

nodes.label: Bakery Package Manager
nodes.description: Cross-platform package manager for bread ecosystem distribution via dl.breadway.dev with minisign signatures.

nodes.label: dl.breadway.dev Distribution
nodes.description: Primary distribution point for bread binaries across dev/beta/stable tracks via bakery.

nodes.label: IPC Protocol
nodes.description: Newline-delimited JSON protocol over Unix socket for CLI and app communication with daemon.

nodes.label: RuntimeState Schema
nodes.description: Complete runtime state snapshot containing monitors, workspaces, devices, network, power, profiles, modules, workflows, and widgets.

nodes.label: API Stability & Versioning (v1)
nodes.description: Bread Automation API v1 guarantees additive-only changes, deprecation windows, and version discovery via IPC.

nodes.label: bread.<app>.* Namespace Convention
nodes.description: Sibling bread* apps publish within their own bread.<app_id>.* namespace; daemon enforces app id uniqueness.

nodes.label: bread.command.<app>.* Command Convention
nodes.description: Outbound commands to sibling apps published as bread.command.<app>.<verb>, best-effort fire-and-forget.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Engine Refactoring
nodes.description: Planned: LSP language server, dry-run checker, SQLite state persistence.

nodes.label: Phase 2: Compositor Abstraction
nodes.description: Planned: Pure Wayland protocol engine, generic DBus adapters, process isolation.

nodes.label: Phase 3: GUI Control Center
nodes.description: Planned: Real-time dashboard with topology graph, event inspector, workflow debugger.

nodes.label: Phase 4: Sandboxing & Security
nodes.description: Planned: Module permission manifests, sandboxed VM execution, capability gating.

nodes.label: Phase 5: Cross-Device Mesh
nodes.description: Planned: Multi-device sync with peer discovery, encrypted event mesh, remote subscriptions.
